name: Starter (no defined strategy yet)
description: For traders who haven't written their strategy down yet: journal the basics, then promote what matters into fields and rules once patterns show up.

plan.summary: Log every trade and skipped setup honestly; let the data show which conditions matter.
plan.bias: Write down the direction you expect and why, before entering.
plan.setup: Name the setup type you believe you are taking.
plan.entry: Note the trigger that made you click.
plan.management: Decide in advance whether you will move the stop or take partials.
plan.no_trade: Tired, tilted, or outside your usual hours.

fields.label: Setup type
fields.guide: Ask the user if it's not obvious from the chart.

fields.label: Session
fields.guide: Market session of the entry, in the trader's timezone.

fields.label: Planned before the session
fields.guide: Ask the user: was this setup on your watchlist before the session started?

rules.guide: Ask the user or call check_risk.

rules.text: Reason for the trade stated before entry
